title: Unethical Particles
description: A resource pack that makes particles VERY visible.
body:
This is a resource pack that makes invisibility particles SUPER visible for PVP.

_I'm also working on a full on PVP pack with the textures using HUE SHIFTING as well so I hope you're hyped to see that.
_
